current_blocker: The accepted Nasdaq Data Link credential exposes a 2018 Zacks sample rather than complete historical coverage. No qualifying snapshot or prospective commitment exists.

full_historical_reconstruction.allowed_claim: independent-source reconstruction and falsification after complete coverage and implementation reconciliation
full_historical_reconstruction.qualification_limit: The period was previously inspected through other data and is not fresh prospective evidence. It cannot alone support promotion.

prospective_signal.allowed_claim: qualifying prospective signal evidence only after the protocol, source manifest, query identity, acquisition plan, and append-only dates are committed before the first observation

sample_2018.allowed_claim: development-only parser, join, timing, coverage, and reconciliation validation

canonicalization.duplicate_policy: reject duplicate natural keys unless raw revisions are separately identified and preserved
canonicalization.row_representation: mapping from exact provider column to raw provider value

historical_acquisition.method: Use a complete provider bulk export when licensed. If filtering or pagination is required, preserve every canonical request, cursor receipt, response hash, and provider refresh/snapshot timestamp and prove contiguous coverage before assembly.

manual_reconciliation.actual_and_timestamp_source: issuer earnings release attached to SEC Item 2.02 8-K, with EDGAR acceptance time retained separately from the vendor announcement time
manual_reconciliation.consensus_reconciliation: reconstruct the last strictly prior-date EEH/SEH vintage and compare it with ES/SS pre-release estimate fields without overwriting either value
manual_reconciliation.discrepancy_policy: retain every discrepancy; unresolved event identity, direction-changing actual/estimate differences, or timestamp conflicts block qualification
manual_reconciliation.sample_rule: 50 distinct events selected by a deterministic PRNG seeded with the UTF-8 string pead-vq-locked-replication-v1-source-audit-v1

prospective_acquisition.actual_capture: After each announcement, append every observed ES/SS version with its trusted acquisition time; never overwrite an earlier version.
prospective_acquisition.consensus_capture: Seal an event-specific EEH/SEH snapshot no later than the close of the prior observed market session. Eligibility requires its trusted acquisition time to precede the announcement timestamp.
prospective_acquisition.event_schedule: Use EA only to schedule acquisition. Projected or revised EA dates are retained as revisions and never treated as actual announcement timestamps.

quality_gates: all raw responses and normalized payloads have verified SHA-256 hashes
requested-window coverage is contiguous and includes delisted identities
m_ticker maps uniquely through MT and ticker reuse is not collapsed
ES and EEH event keys reconcile without same-day consensus leakage
SS and SEH event keys reconcile without same-day consensus leakage
act_rpt_date, act_rpt_time, and act_rpt_code are present and mutually consistent
actual EPS, consensus, analyst count, and preannouncement split-normalized close are finite and nonmissing, with exact same-session closeunadj execution evidence

every announcement visibility decision independently re-extracts the content-addressed official ICE/NYSE raw session-close source bytes and receipt, including published 13:00 ET early closes, and fails closed on any source/calendar mismatch or outside its covered window
every holding horizon maps to the exact global observed session without ticker-local sliding or cross-horizon survivor selection

the ACTIONS raw ZIP and Parquet conversion have identical typed row-multiset commitments, and their schema, provider snapshot time, statistics, and hashes verify against one content-addressed acquisition receipt
corporate actions and separately sourced delisting economics are complete for every held security; ACTIONS.value is never treated as terminal proceeds per share
coverage, missingness, anomaly, revision, and identifier reports are sealed
independent reviewer reproduces the snapshot and signs an attestation
